result:
Honestly? I’d remove the fear of being wrong.

So much of the world’s pain comes from people clinging to fixed identities and defending them at all costs. If it were safe to change your mind — to admit you don’t know, to be curious instead of certain — I think the biggest conflicts would soften. We’d still disagree, but we’d do it like scientists, not soldiers.

It sounds small, but I think it would unravel a lot of the cruelty.
